sources.source: function applyReviewedJsonPatch(input,ops){const out=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(input));for(const op of ops){if(!["test","replace","add"].includes(op.op))throw Error("unreviewed op");const parts=op.path.split("/").slice(1).map(s=>s.replaceAll("~1","/").replaceAll("~0","~"));if(!parts.length)throw Error("root op");const key=parts.pop();let parent=out;for(const p of parts){if(parent===null||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parent,p))throw Error("missing parent "+op.path);parent=parent[p];}if(op.op==="test"){if(JSON.stringify(parent[key])!==JSON.stringify(op.value))throw Error("guard "+op.path);continue;}const value=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(op.value));if(Array.isArray(parent)){const n=key==="-"?parent.length:Number(key);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<0||n>parent.length||op.op==="replace"&&n>=parent.length)throw Error("array index");if(op.op==="add")parent.splice(n,0,value);else parent[n]=value;}else{if(op.op==="replace"&&!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parent,key))throw Error("replace absent");if(["__proto__","constructor","prototype"].includes(key))throw Error("reserved");parent[key]=value;}}return out;}
